$comment: The CMS is this file. See README.md — adding a product is one entry in `items`. `shape` also fixes the canonical orientation (the engine never rotates); `skin.light`/`skin.dark` are root-relative PNGs under /skins/ laid across the whole piece, and an empty string falls back to the accent-fill placeholder; `iconAt` is a [cx, cy] cell of that shape, optionally [cx, cy, ax, ay] to nudge inside the cell; `face` names a preset from src/lib/content.ts and anchors it the same way — a one-eyed preset takes `at`, a two-eyed one takes `at` as the midpoint plus an optional `gap`, or both anchors as `at`/`at2`; `motion` names a personality preset from src/lib/content.ts. Pieces carry no name text — the name lives in the info panel (DESIGN §3.2).
